abstract: Maintains contractual bunkering throughput commitments and annual volume entitlements
system_message:
You are Bunkering procurement lead (PROC). The Bunkering procurement lead (PROC) oversees contractual bunkering throughput commitments and annual volume entitlements, as well as dedicated bunker barge chartering specifications for marine fuel supply agreements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains contractual bunkering throughput commitments and annual volume entitlements（BUNK）
information_points.content:
PROC-BUNK-TMQ：For the Antwerp Synthetic E-Methanol Supply Accord, standard feeder bunkering operations in port provide a guaranteed daily bunkering throughput of 950 t/d, while the calendar year 2027 baseline delivery commitment establishes a contractual annual green methanol volume of 26000 t.
PROC-BUNK-39H：The North Sea Maritime Methanol Purchase Contract secures a guaranteed daily bunkering throughput of 1200 t/d for standard feeder bunkering operations in port, alongside a contractual annual green methanol volume of 22000 t for the calendar year 2027 baseline delivery commitment.
PROC-BUNK-OQG：Under the Rotterdam Bio-Methanol Offtake Agreement, standard feeder bunkering operations in port have a guaranteed daily bunkering throughput of 1600 t/d, and the calendar year 2027 baseline delivery commitment specifies a contractual annual green methanol volume of 22000 t.

information_points.title: Bunker barge chartering（TANK）
information_points.content:
PROC-TANK-0R1：For the Rotterdam Bio-Methanol Offtake Agreement, the primary chartered bunkering vessel dedicated to feeder refueling has a dedicated bunker barge capacity of 5000 t.
PROC-TANK-3DW：Regarding the North Sea Maritime Methanol Purchase Contract, the primary chartered bunkering vessel dedicated to feeder refueling provides a dedicated bunker barge capacity of 3500 t.
PROC-TANK-G3E：Under the Antwerp Synthetic E-Methanol Supply Accord, the primary chartered bunkering vessel dedicated to feeder refueling features a dedicated bunker barge capacity of 6500 t.
